    <t s="3">therefore, the drawing down through teshuvah is into the faculties as they are in a movement of elevation.</t>
    <t s="4">And in order that the atonement of the essence of the day be drawn down also into the revealed faculties as they are in their specific form,</t>
    <t s="5">it is through the mitzvah of teshuvah,</t>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Through teshuvah, intentional sins are forgiven and even turned into merits, and this is especially true during the Ten Days of Teshuvah and Yom Kippur, where the atonement comes from the essence of the day itself, a level higher than that achieved through teshuvah alone, and this is drawn down through teshuvah.

translations.translation: Now, this—that through teshuvah intentional sins are atoned for, and even turned into merits—applies throughout the entire year.
And certainly during the Ten Days of Teshuvah,
for then the teshuvah is of a higher level57.
And the superiority of the teshuvah of Yom Kippur is that the atonement of Yom Kippur is from the essence of the day itself58,
for this atonement is loftier than the atonement achieved through teshuvah.
And this—that Yom Kippur atones only for those who repent—is because
the drawing down of the matter of the essence of the day to the person is through teshuvah.
And the explanation is59,

that this—that through teshuvah the matters that were done contrary to the will are atoned for—is because through teshuvah, there is drawn down from the Essence of Ein Sof, the Master of the Will, who is not compelled by the will.
For this—that the Master of the Will is not compelled by the will—is the matter of the wondrous concealment (hafla'ah) of Ein Sof, and not the actual Essence of Ein Sof60.
And since the matter of the wondrous concealment of the Master of the Will is that He is wondrously concealed from the will,
behold, this proves that the will has a connection to Him
[as is also evident from the fact that He is called "Master of the Will"],
therefore, there must be forgiveness and atonement for that which was done contrary to the will.
However, regarding the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above even the Master of the Will,
there is no concept of blemish ab initio.
And this is the concept of "the essence of the day atones,"
for the atonement from the essence of the day is
(not in a manner of action,
but rather)
that on this day, the connection of the essence of the soul with the Essence
(which is above the Master of the Will) is revealed,
for relative to this level, there is no blemish ab initio.
And the reason that the drawing down of the matter of the essence of the day is through teshuvah
is,
because the rectification of blemishes through the revelation of the essence of the soul
(for from the perspective of the essence of the soul, blemish does not apply ab initio),
does not relate
(so much)
to the matters of the revealed faculties themselves61,
and in order that the atonement through the revelation of the essence of the soul be internal,
it is through teshuvah.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The drawing down of Yom Kippur's atonement into the revealed faculties occurs through teshuvah, which elevates them, and the three aspects of Yom Kippur parallel the three aspects of the shofar blast, with the eight sprinklings in the Holy of Holies representing the revelation of the Yechidah and its drawing down into the revealed faculties.

translations.translation: [And one may add,
that the drawing down of the atonement of the essence of the day into the revealed faculties through teshuvah,
since the matter of teshuvah is that a person goes out of his limitations,
therefore, the drawing down through teshuvah is into the faculties as they are in a movement of elevation.
And in order that the atonement of the essence of the day be drawn down also into the revealed faculties as they are in their specific form,
it is through the mitzvah of teshuvah,
for on Yom Kippur, everyone is obligated to do teshuvah62.
And to note,
that these three matters of Yom Kippur are analogous to the three matters of the shofar blast.
The mitzvah of the shofar blast,
the matter of teshuvah hinted at in the shofar blast,
and the inner self-nullification that comes from the essence of the soul63].
And it may be said,
that this is the concept of the eight sprinklings that were in the Holy of Holies,
one upward and seven downward,
the one upward is the revelation of the Yechidah64,
which is united with the Essence,
and the seven downward
(after the one)
is that the revelation of the Yechidah
(above the chain of descent in man)
be drawn down into the revealed faculties,
the chain of descent in man65.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The distinction between the three "eighth" aspects—of circumcision, teshuvah, and Yom Kippur—is that circumcision reveals a light connected to creation, teshuvah reveals a new light from the Master of the Will, and Yom Kippur reveals the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above even the Master of the Will.

translations.translation: Based on this, we can explain the distinction between the three matters of the "eighth"—
the eighth of circumcision, the eighth of teshuvah, and the eighth of Yom Kippur.
Circumcision is a mitzvah,
and since the original intent of creation is that Israel fulfill all the mitzvos and draw down the revelations that are drawn down through them,
therefore, the revelations drawn down through the mitzvos
(including also the mitzvah of circumcision)
are not truly a new light66,
since the original intent of creation is that Israel draw down these revelations.
And even though the revelation drawn down through all the mitzvos is the revelation of Havayah, and the revelation drawn down through circumcision is above Havayah,
as explained in Torah Ohr67
"Mi ya'aleh lanu hashamaymah"68
its initials are Milah and its final letters are Havayah69,
which indicates that circumcision is above Havayah,
nevertheless,
since the creation of the worlds was originally so that through the mitzvah of circumcision they would draw down this light,
it is a light that has a connection to the worlds.
[And it may be said,
that in general,
this light is also included in Havayah.
For in Havayah, the language of "He who brings into being"70,
there are two levels.
The source from which the coming-into-being of the world is made,
and the will to bring the world into being71.
And since the will to bring into being is that the revelation through circumcision should also be drawn down,
behold, this revelation is included in Havayah.
And that the revelation through circumcision is above Havayah means that this revelation is above the source of coming-into-being].
And the eighth of teshuvah is a revelation of a new light.
For through sinning and blemishing and perverting the path
(contrary to the intent of the creation of man, which was in the manner of "God made man upright")
and afterwards rectifying this through teshuvah,
through this a new light is drawn down that was not
(so to speak)
even in the intent of creation.
However, this light is from the Master of the Will,
who has a connection to the will and intent of creation.
And the eighth of Yom Kippur,
where the essence of the day atones,
is the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above even the Master of the Will.
However, the revelation of this matter is primarily at the time of the entry of the Kohen Gadol into the Holy of Holies.
Therefore,
also the eighth of Yom Kippur is the eighth after the seven days that precede Yom Kippur,
for in general,
also the eighth of Yom Kippur is above the chain of descent that relates to the chain of descent
(the Master of the Will),
unlike the order of the eight sprinklings in the Holy of Holies,
where the one is before the seven.
